description: Check that a revenue recognition schedule sums to its contract value exactly and covers its term with no gap or overlap. A cent either way means that amount is either never recognised or recognised without having been contracted, and both are reported with the exact figure. Periods are treated as inclusive day ranges, so the day after one ends is the day the next must begin, and a gap and an overlap are separate findings because they are opposite errors. Pay 200000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

contract_value.description: The total to be recognised across the term. A decimal string is preferred, because a JSON number cannot hold most two-place decimals exactly and the digits may already differ from what was written by the time they arrive. A number is accepted and that risk is reported.

periods.description: The recognition periods. Sorted by start, so the order supplied does not change the answer.

amount.description: Recognised in this period. A decimal string is preferred, because a JSON number cannot hold most two-place decimals exactly and the digits may already differ from what was written by the time they arrive. A number is accepted and that risk is reported.

end.description: When it ends, inclusive. A calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD.

start.description: When the period begins. A calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD.

minor_units.description: Decimal places per currency code, overriding the published table. Two is the default because most currencies have two.

term_end.description: When the term ends, inclusive. A calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD.

term_start.description: When the term begins. A calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: revenue_recognition_schedule_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

consistent.description: True only when the schedule summed exactly, covered the term with no gap or overlap, and every amount fitted the currency.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Revenue Recognition Schedule Audit
